summary: Inspect the joint interior through reversible layer visibility.
objective: Show a knee with a controlled peel that exposes the menisci and retains a reference pose.
example_prompts: Show a knee with a controlled peel that exposes the menisci and retains a reference pose.

entities.name: Bones
entities.guidance: Preserve recognizable distal femur and proximal tibia landmarks from a sourced model; bone and cartilage need distinct restrained finishes.

entities.name: Menisci
entities.guidance: Make separate named structures at their sourced locations; preserve curvature and thickness rather than flat generic washers.

entities.name: Layer handles
entities.guidance: Separate peel controls from pose controls; retain dotted attachment/reference guides during displacement.

state_contract.model: Sourced structure IDs and immutable rest transforms; peel amount changes display offsets only.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Isolate menisci with surrounding bones visible.

invariants: Exploded offsets do not change attachment metadata.
Do not treat the knee as a mechanically certified single-axis hinge.
motion_guidance: Ease layers along authored nonintersecting display offsets, never a gravity simulation.
If flexion is added, obtain separate kinematic evidence and validate contacts; this record supplies no flexion limits.
known_limits: No ligament force, cartilage deformation or joint load model.
Mesh landmarks and proportions need separate asset verification.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: Menisci in the knee provide cushioning between the articulating bones.
claims.scope: Qualitative structural function; no material or load parameters.
